Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in the initial analysis by assuming that Bell Labs (where Ravi Sethi worked) is the same entity as the current "Nokia Bell Labs." Ravi Sethi worked for Bell Labs when it was a subsidiary of AT&T (historically headquartered in Murray Hill, NJ). The company was later spun off, renamed Lucent Technologies, then Alcatel-Lucent, and finally acquired by Nokia in 2016. While the new owner is Nokia, the corporate entity Ravi Sethi worked for (Bell Labs/AT&T Bell Labs) had its headquarters in Murray Hill, NJ for the vast majority of its existence and was dissolved/renamed long before the move to New Brunswick announced in 2023. The Planner's failure to distinguish between the historical company (AT&T Bell Labs) and the current corporate entity (Nokia Bell Labs) led to the incorrect conclusion that the headquarters is in New Brunswick. The correct answer regarding the company Ravi Sethi worked for (Bell Labs) is Murray Hill, New Jersey.
